verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's FAQ mentions that users can 'aggregate their billing in one place and keep track of all of their usage using our analytics,' implying some usage/cost tracking dashboard exists, but the evidence pack contains no documentation of an actual per-request activity log showing response content, latency, or token counts. Missing for 10: explicit docs on an activity/logs view showing individual request-response pairs, per-request latency metrics, and hands-on/community confirmation of using this for debugging.
